sources.title: Meta playable ads
sources.notes: Single-HTML playable profile with the Meta FbPlayableAd CTA host. Dashboard destination configuration remains separate.

sources.title: Meta playable preview guidance
sources.notes: Official Ads Manager preview and physical devices have not been run by this static rule review.

uploadSize.notes: Conservative decimal 2 MB ceiling on final single-HTML bytes.

packaging.notes: Single HTML with all game assets inline.

inline.notes: No MRAID or external host script is embedded; FbPlayableAd is provided by the host.

mraid.notes: Meta uses FbPlayableAd rather than MRAID.

vendorHost.notes: Deliberate CTA calls FbPlayableAd.onCTAClick() with no URL argument.

autoplay.notes: Muted startup and document-hidden pause are enforced locally.

viewability.notes: Document visibility is the local browser/mock-host lifecycle contract.

orientations.notes: Portrait and landscape are checked locally.

value.instructions: Preview the exact HTML in the official Meta workflow, then test physical devices, both orientations, background/resume, and the deliberate CTA. Dashboard store configuration is required separately; no official acceptance is claimed.

preview.notes: Official preview reference only; not executed.

companionAssets.notes: Campaign-level assets are outside this playable upload.
